stats.source: GOB 508 gives fixed +2 ballistic accuracy and damage bonuses and grants 1136.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives publishes the linked totals and releases the upgrade on unload. AbilityStats.Attack and ScaleTypedAbilityDamage consume the appropriate bonuses.
stats.test: SniperParityTests.SniperDisciplineGrantsTheUpgradeAndFeedsBallisticAttackAndDamage checks both inputs, actual typed attack and damage changes and restoration.

proc.source: GOB 504 stores a 0.1-second term marker at 30% with value 4. ApplyStunWithTimer adds four seconds of stun and an independent immunity. The additional 504 DoNothing callback has no effect.
proc.runtime: AbilityCatalog.Controls preserves the marker, TimedEffects applies the roll, and AbilityConditionalControls.Term checks immunity before adding both timed records.
proc.test: SniperParityTests.ConcealedAndSniperShotsUseTheirOwnDelayedStunProbabilities checks the threshold and delay, pre-existing immunity, and both four-second records and expiry.

script.source: misc.py LineUpTheShot_Test checks existing concealment, then Subject conditionally reapplies it; GOB also reapplies 1137 on initialization and binds a damage-only deactivation to the shorter damage modifier.
script.runtime: AbilityHealthCallbacks.LineUp preserves the pre-cast concealment snapshot, applies timed modifiers and initializes concealment. TimedEffects handles the damage-only callback.
script.test: AbilityHealthCallbackTests.LineUpUsesTwoDurationsPreservesConcealmentAndOnlyDamageBreaksTheParent checks both paths, no break from healing, and the shorter callback expiry.
